name: Whitefly
description: Small winged insects that feed on plant sap and excrete honeydew. Whiteflies cause direct damage through feeding and are major vectors of plant viruses, including cassava mosaic virus and tomato yellow leaf curl virus.
symptoms: Sticky honeydew on leaves supporting sooty mold growth
Small white flying insects when plants are disturbed
Viral disease symptoms if whiteflies are virus vectors
treatments: Apply neem oil or insecticidal soap at 4-5 day intervals
Use yellow sticky traps for monitoring and mass trapping
Apply systemic insecticides (imidacloprid, thiamethoxam) for severe infestations
Introduce biological control agents (Encarsia formosa, lacewings)
prevention: Use reflective silver mulch to repel whiteflies
Plant trap crops (sunflower, marigold) around fields
Remove weed hosts that harbor whitefly populations
Avoid broad-spectrum insecticides that kill natural enemies
Intercrop with tall crops to reduce whitefly landing
